scope: Corollary 6.7 (Realization into a larger level) of the manuscript “Eventual categoricity for abstract elementary classes” (preprints/Eventual-Categoricity-for-Abstract-Elementary-Classes-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 240 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dcb7401285f5ac78), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let ν < µ be sufficiently closed eligible levels. If A → B are ν-objects and A → N is an arrow into a µ-object, then there is an arrow B → N extending the given arrow on A. One may prescribe the image of a tuple of length less than ν whose diagrams over queries in A below ν already match. Types of tuples of length less than ν over A obtained in a larger object are actual ν-types, and the mixed diagram comparisons at those arities agree.
